segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַקּוֹמֶץ מִיעוּטוֹ מְעַכֵּב אֶת רוּבּוֹ, עִשָּׂרוֹן מִיעוּטוֹ מְעַכֵּב אֶת רוּבּוֹ, הַיַּיִן מִיעוּטוֹ מְעַכֵּב אֶת רוּבּוֹ, הַשֶּׁמֶן מִיעוּטוֹ מְעַכֵּב אֶת רוּבּוֹ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «the handful,» failure to sacrifice «the minority of it prevents the majority of it,» which was sacrificed, from rendering it permitted for the priests to consume the remainder of the meal offering. With regard to «a tenth» of an ephah of flour brought as a meal offering, failure to sacrifice «the minority of it prevents the majority of it,» which was sacrificed, from qualifying as a proper meal offering. With regard to «the wine» poured as a libation, failure to pour «the minority of it prevents the majority of it,» which was poured, from qualifying as a proper libation. With regard to «the» log of «oil» that is required for the meal offering, failure to add «the minority of it prevents the majority of it,» which was added, from being a sufficient measure of oil.

segments.he: הַסּוֹלֶת וְהַשֶּׁמֶן מְעַכְּבִין זֶה אֶת זֶה, הַקּוֹמֶץ וְהַלְּבוֹנָה מְעַכְּבִין זֶה אֶת זֶה.
segments.en: With regard to «the fine flour and the oil,» failure to bring «each prevents fulfillment of the mitzva with the other.» With regard to «the handful and the frankincense,» failure to burn «each prevents fulfillment of the mitzva with the other.»

moves.summary: minority of handful, tenth, wine, oil invalidates

moves.cueHe: הסולת והשמן מעכבין זה את זה
moves.summary: flour/oil and handful/frankincense are mutually indispensable

positions.claim: a missing minority of handful, tenth, wine or oil invalidates; flour and oil, handful and frankincense are mutually indispensable
